convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'ColorZerolagJCCX' custom indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Also includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). Multi-component custom indicator with 5 weighted factors requires replication in Python.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timing
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for position open calls

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA starts trading
UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar

other_exits: BuyPosClose is enabled when Osc1[1]<Osc2[1] (bearish crossover on previous bars) - signal-based close of long positions
SellPosClose is enabled when Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] (bullish crossover on previous bars) - signal-based close of short positions

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum (LOT vs other margin modes) controls interpretation of MM value. When MMMode=LOT, MM is treated as fixed lot size. When other modes, MM is a fraction of margin/deposit.

custom_logic_notes: The ColorZerolagJCCX indicator is a zero-lag JCCX oscillator composed of 5 weighted JCCX components (factors 0.05, 0.10, 0.16, 0.26, 0.43 with periods 8, 21, 34, 55, 89). Each component uses JJMA smoothing (Smooth=8, JPhase=100). The crossover logic uses SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar) for signal detection: Osc1[1] vs Osc2[1] determines the prevailing direction, and Osc1[0] vs Osc2[0] at the signal bar confirms the crossover event. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen input booleans gate whether entries are allowed. BuyPosClose/SellPosClose gate whether signal-reversal closes are allowed. The Recount flag ensures failed CopyBuffer calls trigger recalculation on next tick. The CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh controls per-bar signal generation. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate the ColorZerolagJCCX custom indicator which is a weighted sum of 5 JCCX components each using JJMA (JMA) smoothing. The JJMA/JMA algorithm is proprietary and complex - consider using a JMA Python implementation or approximating with a very smooth EMA. The zero-lag composition formula (weighted sum of 5 CCI-like oscillators) must be faithfully reproduced. Signal logic uses bars [1] and [0] from CopyBuffer with SignalBar offset - in Python this maps to comparing previous-bar and current-bar indicator values. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles position open/close with margin mode logic - this must be reimplemented in Python (LOT mode = fixed lots, other modes = margin-based sizing). SL/TP of 1000/2000 points are large values suggesting this EA is designed for H4 timeframe swing trading. No digit adjustment is performed in the EA code itself - the SL/TP values are passed directly to the trading functions, so pip conversion depends on symbol digits.
